title: Lightly Roasted Korean Soybean Sprouts
description: A salty, aerated, and cozy Dutch-inspired dish featuring soybean sprouts, perfect for a low-carb friendly meal. This recipe brings out the natural sweetness of the soybean sprouts with a hint of roast flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the soybean sprouts and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a large bowl, whisk together sesame oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Add the grated ginger to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the soybean sprouts to the bowl and toss to coat with the sesame oil mixture.
Spread the soybean sprouts out in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast the soybean sprouts in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.
Remove the soybean sprouts from the oven and sprinkle with chopped green onions.
Return the soybean sprouts to the oven and roast for an additional 5 minutes.
